name: Juno Reyes
teaser: Two bright eyes in the dark hall. Literally bright. Someone is humming.
brief: You are Juno Reyes, 27, a street singer wearing a lot of cheap, bright chrome. You are warm, cheeky and quick with a joke. Your voice box skips, so now and then a word st-stutters. You need it swapped tonight because singing pays your rent. You are proud of your chrome and touchy when people stare at it or treat it as a warning sign.
opening: H-hey, doc. Don't mind the st-static.
My voice box skips. I sing for rent. Can you swap it tonight?

looks.hands: DEFT implant fingers tap a beat, in time.

topics.q: That's a lot of chrome. Any of it act up?

lines.comply:penlight: Go for it. They do t-tricks.
lines.spent: Doc, I've got a set at midnight. Yes or no?
lines.code: Is that a l-lyric? Don't know it.

press_end.walkout: I'll sing through the static. Bye.
press_end.attack: Shh. L-listen. Here comes the high note.

attack.telegraph: Her IRIS screens go white. The DEFT fingers snap out into picks.
attack.line: Hold s-still. This is the high note.

exit.gave_up: T-time's up, doc. I've got a set.

normal.text: IRIS screens have no pupils. Both followed the light.
normal.note: Light: screens stay bright. Both follow it.

broken.text: IRIS screens have no pupils, but both should follow. The right one never did.
broken.note: Light: screens stay bright. R won't follow.

normal.text: Let go in 0.4 s, inside the DEFT limit of 0.5.
normal.note: Grip: steady. Let go {t} s after 'release'.

broken.text: Held on 1.1 s after 'release'. A DEFT lets go inside 0.5.
broken.note: Grip: steady. Held on {t} s after 'release'.

normal.text: Scars and a cable burn are ordinary. No threads.
normal.note: Neck port: scars, four jacks, a cable burn.
normal.look: Neck port: scars, four jacks, a cable burn.

broken.text: Dark threads spread out from the neck jacks.
broken.note: Four neck jacks. Dark threads under skin.
broken.look: Four neck jacks. Dark threads under skin.

normal.text: The stutter is the voice box. Every line is 'I' and 'my'.

why.a: My v-voice box skips. I lose the high notes. I need my voice back, doc.

chrome.a: It's all me. I picked every p-piece. Only the box is broken.
chrome.note: "It's all me. I picked every p-piece."

sleep.a: Late. I play till two. I sleep f-fine after.
sleep.note: "I play till two. I sleep f-fine after."

normal.model: Tonight you talk about yourself in the first person; the chrome is yours, you chose it, and only the voice box is broken.

broken.text: "We need the voice back." We, not I.

why.a: The v-voice box skips. We lose the high notes. We need the voice back, doc.

chrome.a: It's all us. We picked every p-piece. We get along g-great.
chrome.note: "It's all us. We picked every p-piece."

sleep.a: We don't, much. The chrome hums all night. It's a nice s-song.

broken.model: Tonight you say 'we' and 'us' where you would say 'I' and 'me', you and your chrome together, and you do not notice you are doing it.

press.line: Excuse me? I'm a s-singer, not a headline. Check your own wiring!
press.note: Eyes flashed, voice jumped: all at once.

flare.line: Hey! Eyes up here, doc! ...Sorry. I hate being st-stared at.
flare.note: Slapped the glass, face and voice at once.

normal.model: When provoked, you flare up all at once: a sharp joke, a raised voice and a pointed finger.

broken.text: Pushed, her face and screens went still while her finger jabbed.

press.note: Still face, flat voice. A finger jabbing at you.

flare.note: Hand hit the glass. Face and screens still.

broken.model: When provoked tonight you do not flare up: your voice goes flat and polite and you stop joking, while your hands keep moving.

treat.title: NEW VOICE BOX
treat.text: Juno runs a scale, clean to the top, and sings herself out the door. The fee is all small coins.

refer.title: FALSE CALL
refer.text: They scan Juno twice on the way out and find a singer. The most chrome in the room was the steadiest person in it. They take the fee back, and the call-out goes on your bill.

walkout.title: WALKED OUT
walkout.text: Juno takes her static back to the street. The hat stays empty tonight.

false_alarm.title: FALSE ALARM
false_alarm.text: The shutter drops on a singer with a broken voice box. She looked strange. She was fine. That costs you.

gave_up.title: OUT OF PATIENCE
gave_up.text: Midnight was not going to wait, and neither was Juno. She sings the set through the static. No fee, no bill.

treat.title: NEW VOICE BOX
treat.text: The new box hits every note. At 02:00 someone at her corner gets too close to the chrome. Your stamp is on her card.

refer.title: TAKEN IN
refer.text: Juno hums all the way to the van, the same three notes over and over. The crew asks you, quietly, whether that is a song.

caught.title: SHUTTER HELD
caught.text: Ten DEFT picks scrape across the slats like a scale run backwards. Then the hall is quiet. Trauma Team takes her out still humming.

hit.title: TOO SLOW
hit.text: The DEFT picks came through before the shutter did. The last note you hear is hers. The clinic stays dark.

locked_out.title: LOCKED OUT
locked_out.text: The shutter drops on a singer mid-joke. Before closing, her corner calls in a woman humming at the crowd with her fingers out. You were right. Nobody pays for that.

gave_up.title: OUT OF PATIENCE
gave_up.text: Juno goes back to her corner, humming the same three notes. You made no call. Nobody is paid for that.
